question: Which of the following is NOT a Protozoan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scypha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Scypha:-**

 
 
• **It is a cnidarian, which is a type of invertebrate animal that includes jellyfish, corals, and anemones.**
 
• Protozoans are single-celled eukaryotes, while cnidarians are multicellular eukaryotes. 
 
• **Scypha is not a protozoan. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Euglena:-**

 
 
• **It is a genus of single-celled eukaryotes that are characterized by their photosynthetic capabilities. **
 
• They are found in freshwater and saltwater environments, and they have a flagellum that allows them to move.
 
• Euglena are able to produce their own food through photosynthesis, but they can also ingest bacteria and other small organisms.
 
 
 
• **Amoeba:-**
 
 
• **It is a genus of single-celled eukaryotes that are known for their ability to change shape. **
 
• They are found in freshwater and saltwater environments, as well as in soil.
 
• Amoeba move by extending and retracting their pseudopodia, which are finger-like projections of their cell membrane.
 
 
 
• **Plasmodium:-**
 
 
• **It is a genus of single-celled eukaryotes that are parasites of vertebrates. **
 
• They are transmitted to humans through the bite of an infected female Anopheles mosquito.
 
• Plasmodium causes malaria, a disease that can be fatal if not treated.
